title: Fix positioning of `PopupMenu` submenus
body:
- Fixes #118839
- Fixes #118841

This offsets the sub-menus by the position of `scroll_container`, in order to account for the height of any search bar.

It also incorporates `win_scale` into `scroll_offset`, since positioning seemed to otherwise be broken when the `PopupMenu` list was scaled and scrollable.

As best I can tell, this does not re-introduce #117994.

---
_Disclaimer: AI tooling was used to triage these issues as part of #118571, which prompted some of these changes, all of which I've reviewed to the best of my ability._
